content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I'm new to this forum and new to working with [product_name]. I want to control temperatures above 200°C using a PT100 sensor. What is the maximum temperature range that can be managed with PT100? Is there any solution beyond the default settings of [product_name], or are those limits fixed? Thank you.

Hi, [product_name] supports PT100/PT1000 sensors only up to 200°C. You could use a PT100/PT1000 to 0–10V signal converter. If the converter can handle a wider temperature range for PT100/PT1000 sensors, it should work. Hope this provides some guidance. Regards

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users interested in measuring and controlling temperatures above 200°C with PT100 sensors discover that [product_name] imposes a fixed upper limit. Since this range cannot be expanded using standard configuration, users must look for external solutions, highlighting a restriction in the flexibility of the product for higher temperature applications.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to enable temperature measurement and control beyond the set 200°C limit when using PT100 sensors, preferably adjustable through software.
